NiðthdÞ* þ H2S ! NiSH* þ HðthdÞ
surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites.
evidence: The overall proposed binary reaction of NiS ALD can be written as follows: NiðthdÞ2 þ H2S ! NiS þ 2HðthdÞ. The proposed binary reaction can be divided into two separate half reactions during the two consecutive ALD half cycles as follows: NiSH* þ NiðthdÞ2 ! NiS-NiðthdÞ* þ HðthdÞ; NiðthdÞ* þ H2S ! NiSH* þ HðthdÞ; where the asterisks represents the surface species.
